latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of kiwi-voice skill.
- Provides management and configuration for the standalone Kiwi Voice assistant service.
- Supports flexible TTS (ElevenLabs, Piper, Qwen3) and STT model selection.
- Includes detailed configuration options for LLM, audio devices, and security settings.
- Voice profile management and basic voice security/approval workflows included.
- Troubleshooting tips and log file locations documented for easier support.
